settings.bin_path.label: sushi binary
settings.bin_path.description: Path to the sushi CLI, used to approve or deny permission requests.
settings.auto_open.label: Open on permission request
settings.auto_open.description: Open the panel automatically when an agent session asks for permission.
settings.character.label: Character
settings.character.description: Which pet lives on the notch.
settings.fidgets.label: Idle quirks
settings.fidgets.description: Let the pet do little things at random while idle: hop, wiggle, yawn, wink, sneeze, hum and more.
settings.nap_after.label: Nap after (seconds)
settings.nap_after.description: The pet falls asleep after this long without activity. 0 means never.
settings.widget_info.label: Widget details
settings.widget_info.description: What the bar widget shows next to the pet. The tooltip always has the full progress of the active session.
settings.widget_info.options.session: Plan usage + turn time and files changed
settings.close_after.label: Close after Allow / Deny
settings.close_after.description: Close the panel once the last permission request has been answered, so you are straight back to work.
settings.chat_agent.label: Chat agent
settings.chat_agent.description: Which agent answers in the Chat tab. It runs headless with no tools and uses that agent's own login, so it counts against its plan. Changing it starts a new conversation.
settings.chat_model.label: Chat model
settings.chat_model.description: Model for the Chat tab: a model id of the chosen agent (for Claude Code also sonnet, haiku, opus). Leave empty for the agent's default (sonnet for Claude Code).
settings.sounds.label: Sounds
settings.sounds.description: Let the pet make little sounds (28 of them). The volume follows Noctalia's global sound settings.
